ticker.any_1: Radio: static, then a man selling batteries, then static.
ticker.any_2: Someone painted WIPE DAY on the water tower again.
ticker.any_3: Rule of the camp: if it rattles, it's fine. If it stops, run.
ticker.any_4: A crow sat on the roof all morning, judging.
ticker.clear_1: Clear skies over Saltmarsh. Good drying weather for socks.
ticker.clear_2: Sun's out. The rust is practically glowing.
ticker.rain_1: Rain on the tin roof. Everyone pretends it's applause.
ticker.rain_2: Buckets out: free water, only slightly brown.
ticker.fog_1: Fog in from the flats. Count your fingers, then your crew.
ticker.fog_2: Can't see the skyline. It's still there. Probably.
ticker.night_1: Lights out across the ruins, except ours.
ticker.twig_1: Twig camp: held together with string and optimism.
ticker.wood_1: Timber walls at last. The wind is furious about it.
ticker.stone_1: Stone walls. Nobody can hear you snore any more.
ticker.metal_1: Sheet metal hammered flat. The camp sounds like a drum.
ticker.hqm_1: Armored plates bolted on. Even the rain knocks first.
ticker.mara_1: Mara found a whole plank today. She named it.
ticker.dax_1: Dax swears jerky tastes better smoked over tyres. It does not.
ticker.ivo_1: Ivo talks to the hemp. The hemp seems to like it.
ticker.rook_1: Rook is teaching knots. Nobody can untie the lesson.
ticker.sela_1: Sela measured twice, cut once, and still blamed the saw.
ticker.bram_1: Bram's eyebrows are growing back after the last kiln.
ticker.wren_1: Wren keeps the furnace roaring and her tea cold.
ticker.otto_1: Otto says the tannery smell is character.
ticker.juno_1: Juno's press squeaks in B flat. She tuned it.
ticker.pike_1: Pike checks the Rain Catcher like it owes him money.
ticker.hale_1: Hale pedalled the generator for an hour. The lights blinked twice.
ticker.tamsin_1: Tamsin reads the weather on the radio. Wrong, but warmly.
ticker.gus_1: Gus pulled a car door out of the Scrapyard. It's a table now.
ticker.vera_1: Vera calls the reactor's hum a lullaby. Nobody sleeps near it.

conveyor.name: Conveyor Belts

prefab_walls.name: Prefab Walls

rally_cry.name: Rally Cry

rainmaker.name: Rainmaker

circling_gulls.name: Circling Gulls

hot_breakfast.name: Hot Breakfast

night_lamps.name: Night Lamps

insulated_walls.name: Insulated Walls
insulated_walls.blurb: Night Shift +4 h. Shutters go up and the draughts stay out

all_clear.name: All Clear
all_clear.blurb: Lines +50% while Afterglow lasts. The siren winds down; the crew climb out

moonshine_still.name: Moonshine Still

souvenir_jar.name: Souvenir Jar

forecast.name: Forecast
forecast.blurb: The Big Red's card tells you when the next Wipe Day will count, at this rate

tinfoil_hats.name: Tinfoil Hats

glow_lamp.name: Glow Lamp

flight_school.name: Flight School

tally_wall.name: Tally Wall

weather_log.name: Weather Log

almanac.name: Almanac

big_red.title: The Big Red
big_red.unlocks_later: Nothing new this time. Wipe Day #{m} unlocks: {items}
big_red.small: A small blast: +{gain} is {pct}% of your {ever} glass, so it resets your island quietly and does not count. Wipe Day #{n} needs +{need}.
big_red.wait: Waiting pays more: at +{need} glass this launch doubles your glass ever.
big_red.first: Press it and your own missile flattens your island. Everything you built goes. The glass stays and makes the next island faster.
big_red.note_flotsam: The {flotsam} floating by sinks with the island.
big_red.hold_helper: Hold 2 s. Let go to cancel.
big_red.arm_helper: Then tap again within 3 s to launch.
big_red.locked_first: Someone is building a rocket out of a boiler. The first launch needs {need} crater glass: {have} so far. That comes at {at} supplies made (now {now}).
big_red.locked_later: Nothing to launch yet. The next glass comes at {at} supplies made (now {now}).
big_red.ready_hint: The Big Red is ready. Press it to see what it does.
big_red.other_tab: Wipe Day #{n} happened in another tab.
big_red.not_through: That launch didn't go through: your island changed in another tab.
big_red.line_6: "Wait, my socks are on the line."
big_red.line_8: "Tell me we still have a boat."
big_red.line_9: "The gulls know. Look at the gulls."
